mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_cost_trace (task_id, agent_id, request_id, user_id, conversation_id, steps, tool_calls, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, total_cost, max_steps, status, stop_reason, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{agentId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{steps}, #{toolCalls}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{totalCost}, #{maxSteps}, #{status}, #{stopReason}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_id = task_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_cost_trace SET request_id = #{requestId}, steps = #{steps}, tool_calls = #{toolCalls}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, total_cost = #{totalCost}, status = #{status}, stop_reason = #{stopReason}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, agent_id, request_id, user_id, conversation_id, steps, tool_calls, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, total_cost, max_steps, status, stop_reason, started_at, finished_at FROM ai_agent_cost_trace WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) FROM ai_agent_cost_trace WHERE started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to}
